issues.description: The template implementation of simulate_msd_two_rounds is missing the batch_size parameter present in the problem specification and the solution. The problem statement and solution define simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) but the template declares simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float) without batch_size. This mismatch will confuse students (the docstring in the template even mentions batch_size) and may cause tests or example code that rely on the optional batch_size argument to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template function signature to include the optional batch_size parameter with the same default as the specification (e.g., def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]:). Also ensure the docstring and any internal references mention and use batch_size consistently.
